title: Underlying morphism lift
statement: Let X be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, H, F, F′ coherent modules, and a:F→H, a′:F′→H morphisms whose kernels and cokernels are annihilated by positive powers of J. Given θ:completion(F)→completion(F′) with θ≫completion(a′)=completion(a), there exists g:F→F′ with g≫a′=a.

proof.text: Extract the positive power annihilating ker(a′) from ha′. Apply coherentMap_torsion_completion_ext_zero to obtain a depth n for which ker(a′) followed by the quotient F′ → F′/J^(n+1)F′ is monomorphic. The torsion bound on a is not needed.

At this separating depth use torsionControlledGraphFst_isIso: the finite graph of the prescribed component of θ in F ×_H F′ has invertible first projection. Its epi property uses ha′ and hθ; its mono property uses the separating quotient. Define the witness g as the inverse first projection followed by the second projection, bundled in the full subcategory of coherent modules.

The pullback condition gives graph.snd followed by a′ equal to graph.fst followed by a. Compose with the inverse of graph.fst, use associativity and inverse cancellation, and apply full-subcategory hom extensionality. This proves g followed by a′ equals a. No claim about arbitrary lifts or completion of g is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0889(1), finite-graph comparison with Artin–Rees separation

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_raw
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F F' : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom))))
    (ha' : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom))))
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a) :
    ∃ g : F ⟶ F', g ≫ a' = a

statement_change.what: The Lean signature omitted the completed comparison θ and compatibility hθ that the former prose intended. For J=0, F=F′=H=O_X on Spec(k), a=id and a′=0 satisfy both torsion bounds but admit no lift. Restore exactly θ and hθ as requested by reviewer X-a7def point 4.

old_proof.text: Construct localized comparison maps on an affine basis, descend them by exactness of the formal gluing complex, and glue the resulting coherent morphisms over X.

citers.note: Its hypotheses already include θ and hθ, so its stated use of raw existence still has the necessary premises. This does not validate the separate assertion that every raw lift has completion θ.
